subject: general
question:
Fill in the blanks:

During the modern period, Pt. V.N. Bhatkhande and Pt. V.D. Paluskar contributed significantly to Hindustani classical music by introducing a systematized ______
solution:
The correct answer is __**Notation System**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• During the modern period, Pt. Vishnu Narayan Bhatkhande and Pt. Vishnu Digambar Paluskar made significant contributions to Hindustani classical music by introducing a systematic **notation system**.
 
• The **notation system** developed by Pt. Bhatkhande enabled musicians to document and preserve musical compositions for future generations.
 
• Pt. Paluskar popularized Indian classical music by introducing it to the masses through formalized teaching methods and printed music notations.
 
• The notation system standardized the way ragas were documented, reducing ambiguity and ensuring uniformity in music education.
 
• This systematic approach played a crucial role in transforming Hindustani classical music into a structured discipline that could be learned, taught, and preserved effectively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bhakti Movement**
 
 
• The Bhakti Movement was a medieval Indian religious movement that emphasized devotion to a personal deity and rejected ritualism and caste distinctions.
 
• It was not related to Hindustani classical music directly but influenced devotional music forms such as bhajans and kirtans.
 
• Prominent figures of this movement include Mirabai, Kabir, and Tulsidas.
 
 
 
• **Stage Performance Culture**
 
 
• Stage performance culture in India evolved during the colonial and post-colonial periods as a way to present classical and folk art forms to a wider audience.
 
• While stage performances contributed to the popularization of classical music, they were not directly related to the development of a notation system.
 
• Musicians like Pt. Ravi Shankar and Ustad Bismillah Khan played a significant role in promoting Indian classical music through live performances on global stages.
 
 
 
• **Raga-Ragini Paintings**
 
 
• Raga-Ragini paintings are a form of miniature art that depict various ragas and raginis (musical modes) in Indian classical music.
 
• These paintings were popular in medieval India and are associated with the visual representation of music rather than its documentation or teaching.
 
• They are not related to the systematic development of music notations.
